visualCharacteristics.layout: contained width (~1240px), ~225px tall, text block left half over darkened photo
visualCharacteristics.notes: no CTA, white text, left-to-right dark gradient over photo

contentPattern.structure: 1 column, 2 rows. Row 1 (cell 1) = banner image; Row 2 (cell 1) = H1 heading + intro paragraph(s). Image may also share the text cell; the image loads eagerly as the first visible image of the page
